referenceSources.title: Nissan Micra Challenge – Blackwater Graphics
referenceSources.description:
A blue and white Nissan Micra, branded with PIAA and Yokohama logos and bearing the plate P15 NME, powers through a gravel section of a rally stage. The car’s tires throw up a spray of stones as it drifts around a bend, highlighting the skill required to maintain control on loose surfaces.

In the background, out-of-focus spectators and support vehicles line the course, emphasizing the event’s competitive atmosphere. The combination of sponsor decals, dynamic motion, and rugged terrain encapsulates the excitement of rally racing.
